messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Higher and further education, Media, International politics and organisations, Political behaviour and attitudes, Government, political systems and organisations, and SOCIAL STRATIFICATION AND GROUPINGS in Germany during the 1960s, matching this research need: Survey data on Egyptian students in Germany covering integration with Germans, satisfaction with education, media use, political attitudes toward Egypt and world affairs, views on development, religion, foreign aid, return plans, and demographics.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: dataset survey Egyptian students Germany 1960s integration Germans media use politics development religion return plans
GESIS Egyptian students Germany 1960 survey study
action.query: dataset survey Egyptian students Germany 1960s integration Germans media use politics development religion return plans

"Opinions and Values of Egyptian Students" DOI
action.query: "Opinions and Values of Egyptian Students in West Germany" dataset ZA3331

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Opinions and Values of Egyptian Students in West Germany (1964) — GESIS ZA3331","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3331","justification":"Excellent match and the most directly relevant dataset. Conducted in 1964 by the United States Information Agency (USIA), this survey specifically examines Egyptian students living and studying in West Germany. It is highly relevant to research on students' experiences in Germany, social integration, educational experiences, political opinions, international affairs, economic development, and personal values. The study corresponds directly to the requested population, geographical setting, and historical period. Its subject matter is closely aligned with the research interests in media consumption, attitudes toward Egypt and other countries, development, religion, foreign assistance, and future intentions. Archived by GESIS Data Archive under study number ZA3331, it is the primary dataset recommended for this research."},{"title":"Situation of Afro-Asian Students in the Federal Republic of Germany (1960) — GESIS ZA0195","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.0195","justification":"Very strong supplementary match. Conducted in February 1960 by Prodosh Aich and the Research Institute for Sociology at the University of Cologne, this survey explicitly includes Egyptian students studying in West Germany. The target population consisted of male students from Egypt, India, Indonesia, Iran, and Jordan who had completed at least two semesters of study by the winter semester of 1959–1960. Additional students from Ghana, Nigeria, and Norway formed comparison groups. Interviews took place in Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Heidelberg, and Tübingen. Particularly valuable for investigating the experiences of Egyptian students within German universities, their social circumstances, and their integration into German society. Its multinational design also permits comparisons between Egyptian students and students from other countries. The dataset provides historically relevant evidence from the beginning of the 1960s, although its coverage of specific political and media-related questions should be verified in the questionnaire."}]}
